text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, my weight is still a bit on the heavy side.
So...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll be thorough.
I have to trim away... every bit of waste.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Food intake... restricted. I will sustain myself on the nutrients stored in my body...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(More――even more!
Once weight training is done,
I'll finish up with some cardio...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have a report.
My weight has—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It has drastically decreased.
To the point where it interferes with racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, it was too much.
Her stoic nature seems to have backfired.
If that is the case—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this traditional restaurant...
Is it an all-you-can-eat... Buddhist vegetarian cuisine place?
choice_data_list: Eat up without holding back. Don't worry about the calories.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
It doesn't seem to contain anything unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can eat to my heart's content.
Well then, bon appétit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Believe regained her weight,
succeeding in maintaining moderate self-control.
